title: Rash of Rams injuries will sideline Davante Adams, Poona Ford and Kobie Turner

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rash of Rams injuries will sideline Davante Adams, Poona Ford and Kobie Turner
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Davante Adams will miss six to 10 weeks with a ruptured hamstring and Kobie Turner will be placed on injured reserve.
